text: 10 OVERDOSAGE Overdosage of estrogen or estrogen plus progestin may cause nausea and vomiting, breast tenderness, abdominal pain, drowsiness/fatigue, and withdrawal bleeding may occur in women. Treatment of overdose consists of discontinuation of PREMPRO or PREMPHASE therapy with institution of appropriate symptomatic care.
